summary: computable adjudication and agentic test harness
comment:
Computable adjudication and agentic test harness.

Also written: `caaat-harness`, `ca&at-harness`, `.c&at-harness`, `c@t-harness`

Please be introduced to a cat who acquires things, for whatever purpose — maybe somebody knows.

**Scope:** the platform — skills, schemas, processes, the MCP server and the pipeline. Not what a folio IS (that is folio-assist-core), and not any folio's own content, which lives in its own repository.

links.note: Its own repository since the cutover; the in-tree copy is archived in folio-assistant’s fsh-guts.
